title: West Bengal Budget Live: FM Swapan Dasgupta allocates ₹36,000 cr for Annapurna scheme; ₹14,000 cr for GRAMG scheme; 20% DA increase
description: After BJP’s decisive win in the 2026 assembly elections in the state and Suvendu Adhikari swearing-in as CM in early May, West Bengal will see Finance Minister Swapan Dasgupta table the document for 2026-27
